highlights: A quiet day for broker content: the only broker post was the sector heat map for the 12 Nov close, repeating what the 12 Nov summary already covered.
Telecom, materials and finance led: Sri Lanka Telecom rose 8.1%, Ceylon Tea Services 5.4%, LOLC Finance 4.1% and Tokyo Cement 3.3%; Dialog gained 0.6%.
Banks were mixed and flat: HNB +0.37%, Commercial Bank +0.22%, Sampath unchanged, while NTB fell 0.45% and DFCC 1.21%.
No new broker ratings, targets or dividend cards, so there is nothing to set against the site's fair values.
